blockNote: Spin Dash gate on the Great Wall rampway.

Every frame the actor tests the player's exact pixel position (BranchIfPlayerAt X $0458, Y $00D0). At that spot a Freedan or Shadow player (characterForm other than 0) is left alone, and so is a Will player whose abilityBitmask has bit $0004 (Spin Dash, ability flag $0512) set. A Will player without Spin Dash gets X ($14 of the player actor) set to $03C0. Nothing reacts to an attack and nothing opens: the actor only moves a Will without Spin Dash away from that spot.
